metadata.description: Standalone marketplace for the claude-code-bridge plugin: run shell commands on the user's host from sandboxed agent runtimes via the run_command MCP tool.

plugins.name: claude-code-bridge
plugins.description: Run shell commands (PowerShell, cmd, bash) on the user's host machine from sandboxed agent runtimes like Cowork. Exposes the run_command MCP tool with structured output and permission gating (destructive-op blocklist, admin-elevation detection). Replaces the paste-once handshake of the use-claude-code skill with direct, deterministic shell execution.
